summary: The generated WI treats Stage 1 as the draw operation only (PP-030 / DRAW). Shearing and draw are complete and correct, but the trim & piercing (500 T) and restrike stages, all their settings and dimensions, the panel checker inspection, and packing/dispatch are missing. It also invents tolerances (thickness ±0.05 mm, length/width ±1 mm), a min shut height of 795 mm, D 513, and cushion pin and liner specs. The stage number, stage name, unit and drawing number are wrong, and the RMQP document number is truncated.
